about_the_game:
Drive Me Nutz is the ultimate pulse-pounding driving and racing playground—where every throttle twist, drift and daring stunt can make you famous… or land you in hot water with the cops!

🌆 Explore a Living City

Multiple Districts: From neon-lit downtown streets to sun-baked industrial zones, each area feels alive with traffic, pedestrians and hidden shortcuts.

Fully Functional Traffic System: Stop at lights, yield to oncoming cars or risk a five-star chase!

🏁 Endless Race Modes

Procedural Circuit Races: Compete on procedurally generated tracks that keep you guessing — no two circuits are ever the same!

Checkpoint Trials & Trailblazers: Test your precision and timing as you blast from point to point under the clock.

Go-Kart Showdowns: Lightweight, nimble—and brilliantly chaotic when you bump opponents off the track.

🚨 High-Stakes Police Pursuits

Commit a traffic offense and the law goes Nutz:

Dynamic Chase AI adjusts tactics based on your speed, route and recklessness.

Risk vs. Reward: Evade capture , but one mistake will cost dearly or send you back to the station… and cost you time and money.

🎯 Stunt & Drift Challenges

Dedicated Stunt Arena: Mount “The Hump,” Loop the loop, or duke it out in head-to-head jump races.

🚗 Build, Buy & Customize

Lots of Vehicles: From pocket-sized karts to supercars that hit 500 km/h—each with unique handling and upgrade paths.

Deep Customization: Tweak engines, suspension, handling, decals, paint and custom liveries.

Damage & Repair: Push your ride to the limit, but remember: smash too hard and you’ll need a trip to the repair shop—fast!

🕹 Test Your Skills

Test Track: Hone your laps against ghost cars that mirror your personal best—always pushing you to improve.

“Legal” Missions: If you are busted a number of times you may be required to complete special "re-training" sessions. Swap the sirens for civility: complete objectives and time trials while obeying every traffic law.

🔥 Real-World Physics, Crazy Fun

Our physics engine strikes the perfect balance between authentic handling and over-the-top thrills. Whether you’re carving hairpins in a kart or unleashing raw horsepower in a hypercar, Drive Me Nutz keeps your adrenaline—and bank account—on the rise.

What’s Next?

More city districts, wild stunt arenas, story-driven missions and ride-sharing challenges are all coming soon. Dive in now—and get ready to Drive You Nutz!
